cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 615, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are parking at gate 232, you are fully ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 615，从武汉飞往新加坡，停在 232 号登机口，已完全准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, gate 232, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，232 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: During engine start, you have 1 engine starter failure, you wish to have more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动期间，你有 1 个发动机启动机故障，希望有更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, we have 1 engine starter failure, we need more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，我们有 1 个发动机启动机故障，需要更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, how long do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，你需要多长时间？
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 5 分钟。
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 5 分钟，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, ready for taxi.

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: There is a Boeing 737 approaching you on E3, ask the controller who has the right of the way.
cards.audioTextZh: B：E3 上有一架 Boeing 737 向你接近，询问管制员谁有通行权。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, there is a B737 approaching us on E3, confirm who has the right of the way.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，E3 上有一架 B737 向我们接近，请确认谁有通行权。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, hold at present position, give way to Boeing 737 from your right, he is number 1 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，在当前位置等待，让你右侧的 Boeing 737 先行，他是第一架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold at present position, traffic in sight, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在当前位置等待，看到航空器，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, caution work in progress in the vicinity of E3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，注意 E3 附近有施工。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 右等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 615, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 615，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, caution birds on the vicinity of airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，跑道 36 右可以起飞，注意机场附近有鸟。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, roger, thanks, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，收到，谢谢，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: C: Now you are passing 800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: C：现在你正通过 800 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 615，正通过 800 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, make an Urgency call and advise ATC you want to level off at present level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：巡航期间，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，发出紧急呼叫，并告知 ATC 你想在当前高度改平。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, SIA 615, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, request level off at present level.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，SIA 615，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，请求在当前高度改平。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, roger PAN, when able, say your further intention.
B: The smoke is removed, you have turned off the air conditioning system, you want radar guidance to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，收到 PAN，可以时说明你的进一步意图。
B：烟雾已消除，你已关闭空调系统，想要雷达引导返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA 615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request radar vectors to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA 615，我们已关闭空调系统，请求雷达引导返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: B: You turned off the air conditioning system to avoid high cabin altitude, asked to descend below 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你关闭了空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA 615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request descend below 3000 meters to avoid high cabin altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA 615，我们已关闭空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, do you need any emergency services?
B: Tell the controller you don't need any emergency services, because there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，你是否需要任何应急服务？
B：告诉管制员你不需要任何应急服务，因为飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤。
cards.referenceText: Negative, there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤，SIA 615。
